span.p: Configurations the Helm chart REFUSES to render

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
authMode=cloudflare_headers
+ ingress.enabled=true
a direct route in means anyone
can set X-User-Email

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
authEnabled=false
+ authMode≠disabled
two settings disagreeing about
the auth posture

div.style: color: rgb(254, 202, 202) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
networkPolicy.enabled=true
with no peers declared
an ingress rule with no from:
admits every source

span.p:
401
never anonymous — a shared principal
would pool every caller's credentials
(service tokens land here too)
